integrity: Full analytic proof and reproducible exact-rational auxiliary checks are included. Finite computations do not certify the universal theorem or external originality.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies only to planar convex polygons with genuine extreme vertices; the area bound \(\pi^2/4\) for five or more vertices is not asserted optimal for each n; no higher-dimensional equality claim.
title: Equality cases of the planar Makai-volume flag inequality
